notes.title: Sleepy Sunday - 1.0.6
notes.notes:
- Minor changes were made to the clothing shop, and its characters.
- Difficulty has been reduced (slightly).

notes.title: Bug fixing & Improvements
notes.notes:
Bug Fixing :
- Fixed a glitch that made Oscar unable to hit you.
- Fixed a glitch that made Oscar clip through walls.

Balancing :
- Increased Big Blast's damages.
- Increased Solar Burst's damages.

Quality of life :
- Hurt effects are now clearer.
- Made the clothing shop easier to browse through.
